title: DivineArsenal
description: A very divine arsenal of power
body:
DivineArsenal – Plugin Description

Unleash the ultimate arsenal on your server! DivineArsenal adds three legendary weapons with unique abilities and custom recipes:

Mjolnir - The mythical hammer:

Smash attack triggers lightning strikes.

Press offhand key to strike all entities within 10 blocks three times with lightning.

Passive: Resistance I + immunity to lightning damage.

Tidemourne - The ocean’s wrath:

Press offhand key to drown all players within 10 blocks.

Passive: Water Breathing, Dolphin’s Grace, and Resistance I while in water.

Glock - Full-auto crossbow:

Press offhand key to fire arrows automatically for 30 seconds.

Comes with Quick Charge X (10) and Piercing III (hidden).

Infinite ammo while active.

Additional Features:

Custom shaped recipes for all three weapons.

Cooldowns with action-bar feedback.

Only one of each weapon can be crafted per server. Destroyed weapons are permanent unless restored manually (delete <item>_owner.yml).

Requirements:

Minecraft 1.21+ server

Paper, Spigot, or Purpur

Step into battle and wield the power of DivineArsenal!
